scope_statement: Audit of the exact remediated restricted DIVDRA spatial-distribution candidate only. NO_ADVERSE_DELTA means this qualification introduces no conflicting production change; it is not a system-wide qualification of an invariant outside this process boundary.

invariants.finding: One shared process implementation is qualified; no use-case-specific kernel fork is introduced.
The production routine consumes typed data and contains no file, path, parsing, format or file-unit I/O.
Immutable distribution parameters, hydraulic input, scalar transfer, node result and diagnostics are separate typed inputs and outputs.
The routine adds no persistent per-column state.
Khor, Kver and other distribution intermediates are invocation-local scratch, not persistent column state.
No storage-layout constraint is added; the stateless process boundary remains compatible with batched or SoA runtime storage.
The routine does not mutate committed process state and does not bypass checkpoint, trial, commit or rollback semantics.
The stateless mapping can be recomputed from the same inputs without hidden history.
No day, month, year, midnight or calendar assumption occurs in the distribution routine.
No coupling-window duration or boundary is encoded.
No coupling protocol is weakened or bypassed by this local process mapping.
The groundwater head and flux interface contract is outside this local distribution function; no conflicting convention is introduced.

Scalar drainage transfer remains authoritative; final-node closure preserves scalar-to-node water within unavoidable binary64 summation roundoff, independently checked without a configurable mass tolerance.
Interface response tangents are outside this workunit; no tangent API or Jacobian is changed.
This mapping adds no repeated full-column coupling runs.
The routine is stateless and uses only per-call scratch, consistent with many-column execution without one persistent heavy solver per column.
No MODFLOW cell or tile cardinality assumption is present.
No deep-vadose ownership or routing is introduced.
No transfer-zone transition is implemented here; local scalar-to-node mass is conserved.
The process consumes a hydraulic view rather than one Richards implementation's internal arrays.
Restricted DIVDRA physics is reused behind a process boundary rather than duplicated per solver or use case.
The routine depends on process_hydraulic_view_t and does not expose or require HeadCalc internals.
The frozen 1e-10 Lev2Comp seam is fixed legacy-reference semantics in this candidate and is not exposed as a numerical-policy knob.
The mapping is bounded local work over active nodes and introduces no unbounded retry or fallback behavior.
F-VQ47 preserves and independently checks frozen legacy reference behavior; it does not remove reference-mode availability.
Typed diagnostics expose status, evaluation flags, selected nodes, geometry, anisotropy, transmissivity, raw partition sum and closure correction.
Temporary distribution arrays are allocated only on invocation; no persistent cost is imposed on inactive columns.
No tile fraction, MODFLOW-cell composition or transfer-zone routing is known by the routine.
No hidden file, calendar, midnight, direct-MODFLOW or run-duration assumption occurs.
All 30 architecture invariants are explicitly dispositioned for the exact candidate and qualification scope.
